statement.p: You bought a new car for {\$42{,}000} with a zero interest loan over a five-year period. That means youll have to pay {\$700} each month for the next five years (60 months) to pay it off. According to this information, the equation y={42000-700x} models the loan balance after x months, where y is in dollars. Make a graph of this equation.

hint.p: Two relevant x-values to use are 0 and 60\text{.} (Why?)

solution.p: Time x is measured in months, and this loan will take 60 months to pay off. So we will make a table where the x-values run from 0 to 60\text{.}
